scope: Relocate the Sell flow and Quotes administration surfaces from the Catalog workspace to the Acquisition workspace. The admin Acquisition page is now tabbed (Sell requests / Sell flow / Quotes); the Catalog workspace keeps only catalog resources (Categories, Brands, Product models, Attributes, Attribute sets, Import CSV).

businessFlow.subject: The Acquisition workspace renders three tabs: the sell-request admin queue (default), the sell-flow config (sell entries + build roles with component category and attribute-set override), and the indicative quote config (category/model ranges + history). The Catalog workspace no longer shows the removed Sell flow / Quotes tabs.

notes: The panels were git-mv'd from catalog/ to acquisition/ (relative imports unchanged) and the Catalog workspace dropped the two tabs plus their render branches. SellFlowPanel receives categories + attribute sets fetched by the Acquisition page via catalogApi.categories()/attributeSets().
